structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Exemption of information systems from provisions related to the Virginia Information Technologies Agency
law.text: The provisions of Chapter 20.1 (§ 2.2-2005 et seq.) of Title 2.2 shall not apply to the Prescription Monitoring Program pursuant to this chapter operated by the Department of Health Professions until July 1, 2012, unless an alternate date is mutually agreed upon.
